verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry, data collection, or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted API platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry opt-out, data retention controls, or tracking settings. The closest items, API key governance and expiration, are adjacent security controls and do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
